nodes.title: SG-4.2.5 · Untrack the conflicted vitest cache and dedupe conflict-stage listings
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts holds trackedNodeModulesPaths, parseGitLsFiles, checkTrackedFiles and untrackNodeModules, and scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts runs the cleanup. Desired behavior: a conflicted node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json is untracked with its conflict stages cleared, and a listing that repeats a path across stages 1-3 yields each path once. Why: stale conflict entries must not keep dependency or cache paths tracked or inflate the guard's report.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a git listing containing stage 1, 2 and 3 entries for the same path, when parseGitLsFiles runs, then the path is returned exactly once.
- Given a conflicted node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json, when untrackNodeModules runs with a fake git runner, then it issues a force cached removal for that path that clears the conflicted entry.
- Given a mocked listing with conflict stage entries, when checkTrackedFiles runs, then each offending path is reported once.


## Scope
- In scope: parseGitLsFiles dedupe and stage-prefix handling
- In scope: untrackNodeModules conflict-clearing removal
- In scope: unit tests with a mocked listing and fake git runner
- Out of scope: Resolving merge conflicts in other files
- Out of scope: Phaser source changes
- Preserve: Existing trackedNodeModulesPaths and assertNoTrackedNodeModules behavior
- Preserve: Files stay on disk (git rm --cached only)


## Technical constraints
- Unit tests only; git is faked through the GitRunner type
- No real git index changes in tests


## Definition of done
- Both requirements have passing unit tests
- Existing trackedNodeModules tests stay green


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · parseGitLsFiles deduplicates conflict stage entries
nodes.body:
Context: parseGitLsFiles currently splits NUL-separated output and returns every entry, so a conflicted path appears up to three times, and staged lines of the form '<mode> <sha> <stage>\t<path>' would be returned with their prefix. Desired behavior: strip the stage prefix when present and return unique paths in first-seen order. Why: guard reports and cleanup counts must not be inflated by conflict entries.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given NUL-separated output where the same path appears three times, when parsed, then the result contains it once.
- Given lines like '100644 <sha> 2\tnode_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json', when parsed, then the result is the bare path once.
- Given plain unique paths, when parsed, then order and content are unchanged.


## Scope
- In scope: parseGitLsFiles in src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- Out of scope: Changing the git command used by checkTrackedFiles
- Preserve: Return type string[]
- Preserve: Empty-string filtering


## Technical constraints
- Pure function, no I/O


## Definition of done
- Parser dedupes and strips stage prefix


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Cleanup untracks the conflicted vitest results.json and clears its index entry
nodes.body:
Context: untrackNodeModules runs 'git rm --cached --ignore-unmatch -q' on the results.json path, which git refuses for an entry with unmerged state unless forced. Desired behavior: use -f so conflict stages 1-3 are cleared and the path is untracked while kept on disk. Why: the cache file is tracked and conflicted and must leave the index.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a fake runner, when untrackNodeModules runs, then a call 'rm --cached -f --ignore-unmatch -q -- node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json' is made.
- Given the same run, then the node_modules directory removal call is still made first and no call lacks --cached.


## Scope
- In scope: untrackNodeModules in src/lib/trackedNodeModules.ts
- Out of scope: Running the cleanup against the real repo from a test
- Preserve: --cached so files remain on disk
- Preserve: scripts/untrackNodeModules.ts wiring


## Technical constraints
- Git is only reached through the injected GitRunner


## Definition of done
- Force cached removal of results.json is issued


## Clarifying questions
- None
